conflicts.finding: 2D stress deviator uses /2, displayed strain split and flow use /3. Tracing displayed 2x2 flow does not recover the separately defined plastic volumetric scalar.
Body pos(-devpl)/D versus table devpl/D changes fabric-update sign on dilation.
Literal pressure factor has a pole at p=pzp+pmin and the activation direction differs from adjacent prose under positive body pressure.
Body low-pressure dilation factor uses pmin2; summary uses pmin.
Body postshaking pressure ratio is squared; summary is linear.
Body Dnonrot=-Ad*pos(-dd); summary gives Ad*dd without the guard.
conflicts.status: may coincide only within the negative-dd branch; do not silently generalize

conflicts.finding: Zero previous distance changes branch at <= versus <; initial equal anchors give 0/0 if Eq38 evaluated directly. Startup equality branches xi=0, Mfin=Mcut, Mfin=.9Mb are omitted.
Positive-pressure formulas, nominal .5kPa floor, and signed host min operations are not interchangeable; pA=101300 gives pA/200=506.5Pa.
Old/current/reversal chronology and zalpha/zxp definitions not fully specified by inspected tables.

host.shear: tensorial xy, double contraction counts xy twice; Mandel2 would use sqrt(2)*xy
host.subzones: four triangular subzones, two overlaid meshes; volumetric correction and area-weighted zone updates
host.parallel_shear: independent elastoplastic shear-only element, modulus .01 prepared PM4 moduli, strength max(chg,crhg*compressive pressure), p60
host.standalone_adapter: not yet defined; a homogeneous point cannot silently remove overlays or parallel shear and claim vendor equivalence

transaction_proposal.parent: all subzone states, zone lagged/history/preparation/modes and parallel shear state immutable during trials
transaction_proposal.trial: evaluate full caller from original parent; no extra FirstCall or reset selection in internal Newton probes
transaction_proposal.commit: one atomic accepted caller; rejected candidate restores exact entire parent
transaction_proposal.subdivision: source states no constitutive substepping; changing caller partitions changes lag refresh chronology. An adaptive Atlas variant needs separately declared semantics and partition study
transaction_proposal.zero_increment: do not blindly recompute lag/reversal state on duplicate targets; source-specific zero handling not fully specified
transaction_proposal.time: strain increment / global dynamics dt, not intrinsic viscosity; no automatic PostShake or creep law
transaction_proposal.tangent: piecewise gates, projections, reversal branches and lagged coefficients require transaction-consistent derivative and undefined/singular-branch declarations

tracking_label_gap.note: Diagnostic/property list is not proof of independent physical state. Definitions, dimensions and update snapshots must be pinned before storage.

initialization_steps.reads: host effective stress, raw input parameters, FirstCall
initialization_steps.unresolved: caller must explicitly authorize/model preparation; not an invisible trial reset

initialization_steps.formula: sigma11<0: po=min(pmin,tr2(sigma)/2), pmin=min(pmin,p/200), pmin2=min(pmin2,p/20); sigma11>0: po=-pA/20, sigma=po*I2
initialization_steps.unresolved: signed pressure convention; sigma11==0 omitted; mixed principal stresses not classified

initialization_steps.formula: xi=R/(Q-ln(-100*p/pA))-DR_initial; xi<0: Mb=M exp(-nb*xi), Md=M exp(nd*xi), Ado=2.5*(asin(Mb/2)-phi_cv)/(Mb-Md); xi>0: Mb=M exp(-nb*xi/4), Md=M exp(4*nd*xi), Ado=1.24
initialization_steps.unresolved: xi==0 omitted; arcsine and quotient domains; freeze vs subsequent density update must be specified

initialization_steps.formula: Mcut=max(Mb,Md); Mfin=-2/po*sqrt((sigma-poI2):(sigma-poI2)/2); if Mfin>Mcut: r=(sigma-poI2)/po*Mcut/Mfin, sigma=poI2+po*r, alpha=r*(Mcut-m)/Mcut; if Mcut>Mfin: r=(sigma-poI2)/po, alpha=r
initialization_steps.unresolved: equality omitted; table note says update Mfin if stress projected
